title: Rolex Sky-Dweller Mint Green Dial 336934-0002 - Rolex Certified Pre-Owned Watch Review
description:
Rolex Certified Pre-Owned Sky-Dweller (336934-0002) features a 42mm stainless steel case with an 18k white gold fluted bezel surrounding a mint green dial on a stainless steel jubilee bracelet. Functions include hours, minutes, seconds, date, annual calendar, GMT and month. This watch has received Rolex-authorized service and certification. This Rolex Sky-Dweller watch also measures 14mm in thickness and 50.4mm from lug-to-lug.
